newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca says launches migraine treatment.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca says launches migraine treatment.

text.p: Zeneca Pharmaceuticals, part of the Zeneca Group, said on Monday that it had launched its new oral migraine treatment 'Zomig' which made its entry into a worldwide market seen reaching 1.5 billion stg by 2000.
The treatment is being launched after it completed a clinical trial programme on 4,000 patients, treating 50,000 migraine attacks over periods of up to one year.
UK was the first country to approve marketing of Zomig when it did so on March 10. Sweden became the second country on March 24.
Intake of Zomig can bring rapid relief of migraine symptoms within a hour.
"These features, together with a simple oral dosing regimen, mean that 'Zomig' represents a major opportunity for Zeneca," the company said.
Migraine is a common disorder worldwide and according to estimates there are almost six million migraine sufferers in the UK.
